faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Assistant-I post is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant-I position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BCA/B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. or equivalent with at least 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in 10th and 12th grades.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-I position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Assistant-I post ranges from Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 53,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant-I jobs?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Gandhinagar website.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the job type for this recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is OTH/12286/Adv0312.
